verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at docs.treasuryprime.com (HTTP 200) that indexes the developer documentation with links to Markdown pages. The doc pages themselves are served as .md URLs, giving agents clean machine-readable content to follow. Missing for 10: no first-party guidance on using the docs with agents, no evidence of an llms-full.txt or similar consolidated file, and no publicly discoverable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404).
